resources.string: How should the watch detect your gesture?
Uses the watch’s built-in recognition. No calibration or sensitivity controls.
Detects wrist movements with your calibration. It may trigger accidentally and uses more battery while the player is open.
Not calibrated yet. Complete the test before saving this mode.
Open Svartifoss on the watch. Follow the test there and save your calibration.
Continue on the watch. If the test does not open, reopen Svartifoss there and try again.
Watch unavailable. Check the connection and update both apps, then try again.
Increase if pinches are missed. Decrease if other movements trigger actions.
Maximum time from the first pinch to the second. Increase for a slower gesture.
How long to wait after an action before accepting another gesture.
These settings apply while music is playing or paused.
Touch thumb and index finger together twice, with the player open and the watch screen awake.
